g.text: Waiting on a real backend shouldn't block frontend work. PhantomBack spins up a full
REST API from a schema — JWT auth, pagination, filtering, sorting, nested relations —
with realistic seeded data. Reality Mode then breaks it on purpose: random 5xx
errors, latency spikes, dropped connections, corrupted responses, hanging timeouts —
so retries and error handling actually get tested. Published as an npm package with a
